shopSales.noBuyersBody: Customers of type retail shop, supermarket chain, wholesale or distributor show here. Add them on Sales → Customers.
shopSales.noCollectionsBody: The salesman records each collection on his phone; the shop gets a WhatsApp receipt.
shopSales.counterBody: Counter billing at the own shops: bill at MRP, the bill goes by WhatsApp or print.

shopSales.chequeRule: Cheques: received → deposited → cleared or bounced. A bounced cheque puts the debt back and triggers a credit review.
